newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds tread water ahead of U.S. price data.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds tread water ahead of U.S. price data.

text.p: Danish benchmark bond prices were little changed Thursday midday as investors awaited key U.S. inflation data before deciding to move any money.
"We're sitting waiting for this afternoon's U.S. PPI and holding existing levels in the meantime. After the numbers the market could go either way," a dealer said.
At 1050 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was unchanged from its opening 104.95, having traded between 104.85 and 105.00 during the morning in turnover of two billion crowns.
Its September future was untraded at 104.72.
The six percent mortgage bond due 2026 gained 0.20 point to 82.90.
The crown traded at 3.8542 per mark, firming further from its earlier 3.8549.
The 10-year yield gap with Germany was unchanged at 96 basis points. --Claus Mathisen, Copenhagen newsroom, 45-33-969652
